eloquent: fluent or persuavsive in speaking or writing
curious: wanting to know or learn something
adapt: To change easily to fit new situations in life.
bloom: To grow open up and become healthy and beautiful.
bright: Shining with a lot of light, like a star in space.
cosmic: Huge, grand, and beautiful like the universe.
evolve: To grow and improve slowly over time in nature or life.
fusion: Joining different things together to make something powerful.
galaxy: A massive, beautiful system of stars and planets.
genius: A person who is exceptionally smart, creative, or talented.
glow: To give off a soft, warm, and happy light.
smart: Clever, quick to learn, and efficient like modern technology.
